Selected work

Selected courses, platforms, videos, interfaces and learning-related applications. Open any item to see the brief, my contribution and the result.

Courses and learning

  • CBREmyBuy TrainingCBRE was introducing Coupa as myBuy. I developed task-based system simulations in Show Me, Try Me and Test Me modes, giving staff a chance to practise before go-live. I also coordinated the French adaptation.
  • UNECESustainable Inland Transport Connectivity Indicators (SITCIN) moduleUNECE needed government officials to understand its transport-connectivity indicator framework. I designed and wrote a self-paced course of up to 180 minutes, including interactive content and AI-assisted media. The programme was prepared in English and adapted for French and Russian audiences.
  • OSCEOnline Security Management courseI designed a seven-module OSCE security-management course, built the modules in Storyline and published them to TalentLMS. The reusable course template also supported later development.
  • KPMGClient Management OverviewKPMG UK moved its staff to Microsoft Dynamics CRM. Working inside the change team, I built role-based e-learning, job aids and videos, so each group learned the part of the system it uses.
  • ClarksonsTrainee Broker ProgrammeClarksons, a company of 1,379 staff in 46 offices worldwide, needed one licence programme for trainee shipbrokers. I built 20 units of competency with assessments and interactive visual aids.
  • NSW Community ServicesKeep Them Safe (KTS) Reforms ProgrammeNSW Community Services needed online training for NGO staff on the major child-protection law changes in the Keep Them Safe reforms. I built all nine modules of the programme in Adobe Captivate, with case studies to practise on. The demo is Module 1, the overview.

Video and explainers

  • CBRECBRE Restatement Playbook EvaluationCBRE needed staff to understand its restatement playbook. I wrote and storyboarded a short explainer, then produced the video using VideoScribe and Synthesia.
  • OSCEConfidence-Building Measures ExplainerPart of an OSCE course on cyber and ICT confidence-building measures. I turned dense policy material into a short narrated explainer for staff and mission members.
  • UNECEeTIR website launch promotional videoThe new eTIR website needed a short film to introduce the system. The TIR secretariat wrote the script, and I storyboarded, animated, edited and captioned "eTIR turn borders into bridges".
  • OSCEThe Vienna Document explainerPart of the OSCE Forum for Security Co-operation programme for participating States and their points of contact. A short explainer of the Vienna Document and what it asks of each State.
  • OSCEConfidence-building measures explainerPart of the same Forum for Security Co-operation programme. It explains confidence- and security-building measures in a few minutes, with animation and AI video.

Interactions and simulations

  • Marshall ADGFOD & Safety Awareness refresherA micro-learning refresher for the Marshall Aerospace and Defence Group training centre on foreign object debris and the habits that keep a site safe. Rise modules with Synthesia video, edited in Premiere.
  • KPMGCustom Articulate Storyline 360 interactionA custom Storyline 360 interaction from the KPMG system rollout training, where staff practise a step before they meet it in the live system.
  • OSCECustom Articulate Storyline 360 interactionA custom Storyline 360 interaction built for an OSCE staff course.
  • ClarksonsInteraction: Clean Tanker RoutesTrainee brokers at Clarksons had to learn the six Baltic Clean Tanker routes and the cargo each one carries. I turned the route data into an interactive map they explore at their own pace.

Platforms and websites

  • UNECEUNECE eTIR WebsiteCustoms authorities and transport associations needed clear, role-specific guidance on the eTIR system. I scoped, designed and built the Drupal website with the OSCE and UNECE, including a searchable documentation structure and administrator handover.
  • UNECEUNECE SITCIN WebsiteUNECE asked for a public-site redesign. The audit revealed a deeper problem: officials could not complete an assessment reliably. I redesigned the focal point experience and rebuilt the core Drupal workflow, added new indicators and supported a three-country pilot. Live since June 2026.
  • Advanced Learning WorldAdvanced Learning World platformAdvanced Learning World is a bilingual, mentor-led platform for Saudi K-12 students, built on Open edX with a custom front end. As Learning Technology Lead and Solution Architect, I represented the client across content, UX, platform requirements and testing, working with delivery partner EPAM.
  • Advanced Learning CompanyAdvanced Learning Company websiteThe Advanced Learning Company website supported the learning business and its product launch. I helped define the structure, design the pages and build the website in 2016, then updated it for the 2020 platform release.

Apps and tools

  • ClarksonsKnowledge visualisation appI developed an interactive knowledge map to help Clarksons staff explore the relationships between the company's information and terminology.
  • Own productFlexTab: tab, slider and accordion configuratorA live configurator for tabs, sliders, flip cards and accordions. Change typography, layout, colours and effects, then export HTML and CSS for learning modules or websites.
  • Own productSCORM Package EditorA browser-based tool for inspecting and editing SCORM packages. Open a ZIP file, explore the course assets, make targeted edits and export an updated package. Optional XLIFF support helps with localisation workflows.
  • Own productVibeListAn organised directory of AI building tools, including information about exporting and retaining your work. I use it to compare software before committing a project to a tool.
  • Own productVaikend: family events searchCurated, directly searchable events for families in Vilnius (Kaunas coming soon). Pick a date range, filter by children's age and choose from trusted local sources.
  • Own productKidness: exercise app for childrenAn experiment that helps children exercise for 15 minutes a day with no equipment. Kids pick a name, an avatar and a colour theme, then follow bodyweight exercise demos.
  • Own productLT·GOV: who holds power in LithuaniaA bilingual interactive map that teaches who exercises state power in Lithuania and where that authority comes from. It links constitutional provisions to offices, elections and guided classroom stories.
  • Own productDesign Atlas: 51 web stylesA visual reference and learning resource covering 51 design styles. Each page demonstrates a style, explains its origins and includes a prompt that can be adapted for an AI-assisted design tool.
  • Own productLT School Atlas: schools comparedA comparison tool for families and educators exploring private and international schools in Lithuania. Schools can be filtered by curriculum, teaching language and qualification.
  • ClarksonsAbbreviation/Glossary AppShipping runs on abbreviations. I built a searchable glossary app so Clarksons staff can find any term and its meaning in seconds, by search or by category.
